title: Write down three good things from the day.
subtitle: Gratitude practice
rationale: Bias the end-of-day review toward what worked, cheaply and in under five minutes.

evidence.summary: Experimental studies show gratitude listing modestly improves wellbeing and mood versus neutral or negative journaling.

indications: Days end on the unfinished-work list by default.
Mood skews negative despite objectively good progress.
